Maratha Quota Activist on Hunger Strike, Government Offers Talks

Maratha community activist Manoj Jarange began a hunger strike on September 11, demanding the government accept his community's quota demands. He set a September 12 deadline for the Maharashtra government to respond. Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis stated the government is willing to discuss the "legally valid" demands of the Maratha community. Jarange warned of demonstrations in Mumbai if his demands are not met.
